caption: The drawing depicts a single, large metallic key positioned diagonally with the key's teeth facing toward the upper left corner and the round bow (handle) toward the lower right. The key is colored in shades of gold and brown, suggesting a brass or bronze material. Its shaft is cylindrical, and the bow is circular with a slightly thickened outer edge. The teeth of the key form a complex, geometric pattern with three prominent rectangular protrusions and multiple right angles. The background is a plain, off-white color with no additional objects or details, except for a small handwritten label in black ink on the right side that reads “DANIEL GRANT – DEL. 550-1.”
title: Brass Key
